from pathlib import Path
Path("src/journal/version.py").write_text('VERSION = "4.27.1"\n')
line = "- Merging a worker's work finishes its task before letting the worker go, so the task is never told as open again on the way to done."
p = Path("src/journal/CHANGELOG.md"); s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("## 4.27.0\n", f"## 4.27.1\n\n{line}\n\n## 4.27.0\n", 1)
p.write_text(s)
Path("/EXAMPLE-KEY.27.1.md").write_text(line + "\n")
EOF

finished." && git push -q origin development && git push -q origin development:main && gh release create v4.27.1 --target main --title 4.27.1 --notes-file /EXAMPLE-KEY.27.1.md

command:
grep -n "^def eventually" tests/test_features.py && python3 - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("tests/test_features.py")
t = p.read_text()
a = "def test_nothing_is_installed_on_its_own_when_no_release_is_newer(app: App):"
b = '''def test_the_updater_asks_for_a_new_release_as_often_as_the_setting_says(app: App):
    source = Source("v4.0.0")
    updating = updating_with(app, source, Installer(), auto=False)
    app.container.get(SettingRows).set("updates.check_minutes", 5, Actor.system())
    first = timing.time() + 60
    for time, asked in ((first, 1), (first + 299, 1), (first + 300, 2)):
        updating.tick(time)
        assert eventually(lambda: len(source.tags_asked) == asked), f"at {time - first:.0f} seconds the releases were asked {len(source.tags_asked)} times"


''' + a
assert t.count(a) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(a, b))
EOF
